text:
ashley.csm: kicking off quick sync for DataLane private VPC — need to validate audit-log routing, KMS key policy, and cross-account IAM before cutover. available window today 4-5pm PT?

sara.dhsre: thanks! can do 4:30 PT. primary concern is log retention >=365 days and encrypted-at-rest with our key.

raj.solutions: pinging infra owners — mike, can you confirm we can accept a customer-managed CMK? also need the exact S3 bucket arn for the subscription filter.

mike.infra: we can support a customer CMK but need its key policy to allow: redwood-priv-prod@account-id, LogsDelivery principal, and our KMS decrypt/describe. sample policy snippet:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-priv-prod"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"]}
  ]
}
```

elsa.security: also need to confirm key rotation & that CMK is in same region. if they want external HSM we'll need SOC docs.

sara.dhsre: CMK will be customer-managed in same region, rotation enabled. what's next for audit forwarding? we plan to push flow logs + cloudtrail via kinesis -> splunk.

ashley.csm: flow logs and cloudtrail OK. infra to confirm subscription filter pattern and required IAM role trust. mike: can you paste the CLI we will ask their SRE to run to bind the role?

mike.infra: sure — ask them to create role `redwood-priv-log-forwarder` with trust for `logs.amazonaws.com` and attach this policy:

```
aws iam create-role --role-name redwood-priv-log-forwarder --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name redwood-priv-log-forwarder --policy-name ForwarderPolicy --policy-document file://forwarder.json
```

raj.solutions: FYI we also need NAT egress CIDR whitelist from customer's security team — 3 outbound IPs from our VPC for splunk ingestion.

sara.dhsre: i'll ask networking to open those. how do we document the audit log proof of delivery for compliance review?

ashley.csm: after cutover we'll run a 48h proof with sample hashes + S3 object metadata and share in the compliance packet. tagging: @elsa.security to own the packet.

elsa.security: will take it. also loop in legal for retention policy confirmation.

logs-bot: audit-forwarder: subscription-status=waiting_for_role (role redwood-priv-log-forwarder) — ETA 4h

sara.dhsre: thanks everyone. see you at 4:30 PT — will post the CMK ARN + bucket arn in this thread before the call.

ashley.csm: perfect — i'll send calendar invite and attach the preflight checklist. :white_check_mark:
